comment: Test cases: public Onshape documents of the Rhoban 'onshape-to-robot tests' folder, pinned to their 'tests-v1' version. 'config' entries are added to the generated config.json.

cases.name: subasm-robot
cases.description: Synthetic: two arm sub-assemblies, a leg nesting an articulated knee, frame_/link_ connectors in sub-assemblies, an unmated part

cases.name: subasm-reused-arm
cases.description: Synthetic: the same articulated arm sub-assembly instantiated twice

cases.name: subasm-linked-arm
cases.description: Synthetic: an articulated arm inserted from another document (linked library)

cases.name: quadruped
cases.description: Rhoban quadruped, all DOFs at the root

cases.name: quadruped-legs-flexible
cases.description: Same quadruped (same DOFs and pose) with flexible leg sub-assemblies

cases.name: quadruped-legs-locked
cases.description: Same quadruped with locked leg sub-assemblies

cases.name: quadruped-shared-leg
cases.description: Same quadruped with one leg element instantiated 4 times

cases.name: sigmaban
cases.description: Rhoban Sigmaban (2023), positioning lock mates suppressed

cases.name: sigmaban-legs
cases.description: Same Sigmaban with leg sub-assemblies, each nesting a shin sub-assembly

cases.name: quadruped-docs-example
cases.description: The quadruped used as example in the documentation

cases.name: features-mechanisms
cases.description: Built for the tests: continuous wheel (with limits enabled in Onshape), ball joint limited by a variable, fixed DOF, slider limited by variables, gear relations (ratio 2, ratio 3 reversed), fix_ mate, mate group, surface part

cases.name: features-mechanisms-euler
cases.description: Same, with the ball joint replaced by revolute joints (ball_to_euler), so that it can be exported to URDF

cases.name: features-closures
cases.description: Built for the tests: closing mates of every type (fastened, revolute, ball, slider)

cases.name: features-configured
cases.description: Built for the tests: joint limits and their activation depending on a configuration (default configuration)

cases.name: features-configured-large
cases.description: Same, other configuration (list parameter given by its label, boolean given as a JSON boolean)

cases.name: features-configured-unlimited
cases.description: Same, with the limits of the elbow disabled by the configuration
